```lean
    (hL : L ∈ line[ℝ, C, A]) (hPL : line[ℝ, P, L].direction ⟂ line[ℝ, C, A].direction) :
    dist P A + dist P B + dist P C ≥ 2 * (dist P M + dist P N + dist P L)
```

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
(n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 2) :
  letI f := truncatedExp n
  if n % 4 = 0 then
    -- Galois group is alternating group A_n
    Nonempty (f.Gal ≃* alternatingGroup (Fin n))
  else
    -- Galois group is symmetric group S_n
    Nonempty (f.Gal ≃* Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
```

```lean
(G : SimpleGraph V) (h_conn : G.Connected) :
    letI centers := { v : V | G.eccent v = G.radius }
    letI r_nat := G.radius.toNat
    letI sphere_verts (v : V) : Set V := { w | G.dist v w = r_nat }
    letI sphere_size (v : V) : ℝ := ↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun w => w ∈ sphere_verts v)).card
    letI max_sphere_size := sSup (sphere_size '' centers)
    max_sphere_size ≤ Ls G
```

```lean
    ∀ (𝓒 : ℤ → ℤ), (Set.range 𝓒).Finite →
      -- There exists integers `a, b, c`
      ∃ (a b c : ℤ),
      -- that are non-zero and distinct.
      [a, b, c, 0].Nodup ∧
      -- `a, b, c` satisfy the equation
      (1/a : ℝ) = 1/b + 1/c ∧
      -- `a, b, c` have the same color
      (𝓒 '' {a, b, c}).Subsingleton
```

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
:
    answer(True) ↔
    -- For any finite colouring of the integers
    ∀ (𝓒 : ℕ → ℕ), (Set.range 𝓒).Finite →
      -- there are integers `2 ≤ n₁ < ⋯ < n_k`
      ∃ S : Finset ℕ, (∀ n ∈ S, 2 ≤ n) ∧
        -- whose reciprocals sum to `1`
        ∑ n ∈ S, (1 / n : ℚ) = 1 ∧
        -- and which all have the same colour
```

## S5-CLM-00006625 — Besicovitch covering theorem

- 来源定位 / Source pointer：https://github\.com/leanprover\-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Covering/Besicovitch\.lean\#L825\-L854

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [HasBesicovitchCovering α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ]
  (f : α → Set ℝ) (s : Set α),
  (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ δ > 0, (f x ∩ Set.Ioo 0 δ).Nonempty) →
    ∀ (R : α → ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ s, 0 < R x) →
        ∃ t r,
          t.Countable ∧
            t ⊆ s ∧
              (∀ x ∈ t, r x ∈ f x ∩ Set.Ioo 0 (R x)) ∧
                μ (s \ ⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x (r x)) = 0 ∧ t.PairwiseDisjoint fun x => Metric.closedBall x (r x)
```

## S5-CLM-00006689 — Central limit theorem

- ID：`S5-CLM-00006689`
- 名称 / Name：Central limit theorem
- 类型 / Kind：`theorem`
- 来源 / Source：`SRC-MATH-V5-MATHLIB-8A178386`
- 来源定位 / Source pointer：https://github\.com/leanprover\-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/Probability/CentralLimitTheorem\.lean\#L119\-L152
- 来源版本 / Origin release：`5.3`
- 陈述形式 / Representation：exact runtime formal type
- 权利边界 / Rights boundary：Apache\-2\.0 formal statement with attribution; catalog does not relicense source
- 归属 / Attribution：The mathlib Community

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {Y : Ω' → ℝ} [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'],
  ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Y (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ProbabilityTheory.variance (X 0) P).toNNReal) P' →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp (X 0) 2 P →
      ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) →
          MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n ω => (√↑n)⁻¹ * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω - ↑n * ∫ (x : Ω), X 0 x ∂P)) Filter.atTop Y (fun x => P)
            P'
```

```lean
    EuclideanGeometry.angle a p c = Real.pi →
      EuclideanGeometry.angle b p d = Real.pi → dist a b * dist c d + dist b c * dist d a = dist a c * dist b d
```

## S5-CLM-00006728 — Taylor's theorem

- ID：`S5-CLM-00006728`
- 名称 / Name：Taylor's theorem
- 类型 / Kind：`theorem`
- 来源 / Source：`SRC-MATH-V5-MATHLIB-8A178386`
- 来源定位 / Source pointer：https://github\.com/leanprover\-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/Taylor\.lean\#L365\-L385

- 归属 / Attribution：The mathlib Community

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ},
  x₀ < x →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n) f (Set.Icc x₀ x) →
      DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Set.Icc x₀ x)) (Set.Ioo x₀ x) →
        ∃ x' ∈ Set.Ioo x₀ x,
          f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Set.Icc x₀ x) x₀ x =
            iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.Icc x₀ x) x' * (x - x') ^ n / ↑n.factorial * (x - x₀)
```

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [inst_1 : RCLike 𝕜]
  {E : Type u_3} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {bound : α → ℝ}
  {F : 𝕜 → α → E} {x₀ : 𝕜} {s : Set 𝕜},
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    (∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in nhds x₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (F x₀) μ →
        ∀ {F' : 𝕜 → α → E},
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) μ →
            (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖F' x a‖ ≤ bound a) →
              MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ →
                (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' x a) x) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (F' x₀) μ ∧
                    HasDerivAt (fun n => ∫ (a : α), F n a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), F' x₀ a ∂μ) x₀
```

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [inst_1 : RCLike 𝕜]
  {E : Type u_3} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {bound : α → ℝ}
  {F : 𝕜 → α → E} {x₀ : 𝕜} {s : Set 𝕜} {F' : α → E},
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    (∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in nhds x₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (F x₀) μ →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F' μ →
          (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, LipschitzOnWith (Real.nnabs (bound a)) (fun x => F x a) s) →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ →
              (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, HasDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' a) x₀) →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable F' μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ (a : α), F x a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), F' a ∂μ) x₀
```

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [inst_1 : RCLike 𝕜]
  {E : Type u_3} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_4}
  [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_6 : NormedSpace 𝕜 H] {F : H → α → E} {x₀ : H} {bound : α → ℝ} {s : Set H}

        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) μ →
          (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖F' x a‖ ≤ bound a) →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ →
              (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' x a) x) →

```

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} {H : Type u_3} {M : Type u_4} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
```

```lean
              ContMDiffOn I (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ F) (↑n) f U →
```

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {a b : ℝ} {f g : ℂ → E},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b) →
    (∃ c < Real.pi / (b - a),
        ∃ B,
          f =O[Filter.comap (abs ∘ Complex.im) Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b)] fun z =>
            Real.exp (B * Real.exp (c * |z.im|))) →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ g (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b) →
        (∃ c < Real.pi / (b - a),
            ∃ B,
              g =O[Filter.comap (abs ∘ Complex.im) Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b)]
                fun z => Real.exp (B * Real.exp (c * |z.im|))) →
          (∀ (z : ℂ), z.re = a → f z = g z) →
            (∀ (z : ℂ), z.re = b → f z = g z) → Set.EqOn f g (Complex.re ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b)
```

## S5-CLM-00007271 — taylor\_mean\_remainder

- ID：`S5-CLM-00007271`
- 名称 / Name：taylor\_mean\_remainder
- 类型 / Kind：`theorem`
- 来源 / Source：`SRC-MATH-V5-MATHLIB-8A178386`
- 来源定位 / Source pointer：https://github\.com/leanprover\-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/Taylor\.lean\#L290\-L315
- 来源版本 / Origin release：`5.4`
- 陈述形式 / Representation：exact runtime formal type
- 权利边界 / Rights boundary：Apache\-2\.0 formal statement with attribution; catalog does not relicense source
- 归属 / Attribution：The mathlib Community

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {f g g' : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ},
  x₀ < x →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n) f (Set.Icc x₀ x) →
      DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Set.Icc x₀ x)) (Set.Ioo x₀ x) →
        ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc x₀ x) →
          (∀ x_1 ∈ Set.Ioo x₀ x, HasDerivAt g (g' x_1) x_1) →
            (∀ x_1 ∈ Set.Ioo x₀ x, g' x_1 ≠ 0) →
              ∃ x' ∈ Set.Ioo x₀ x,
                f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Set.Icc x₀ x) x₀ x =
                  ((x - x') ^ n / ↑n.factorial * (g x - g x₀) / g' x') • iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.Icc x₀ x) x'
```

```lean
∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ -↑n) →

        ↑N ^ (s - 1) * (2 * ↑Real.pi) ^ (-s) * Complex.Gamma s *

```

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} {hm : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [BorelSpace α] [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {g : α → E}
  {l : Filter ι} {x₀ : α} {s : Set α} {φ : ι → α → ℝ} {a : E} [CompleteSpace E],
  MeasurableSet s →
    ∀ {t : Set α},
      MeasurableSet t →
        t ⊆ s →
          t ∈ nhdsWithin x₀ s →
            μ t ≠ ⊤ →
              (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ φ i x) →
                (∀ (u : Set α), IsOpen u → x₀ ∈ u → TendstoUniformlyOn φ 0 l (s \ u)) →
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ∫ (x : α) in t, φ i x ∂μ) l (nhds 1) →
                    (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in l, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (φ i) (μ.restrict s)) →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn g s μ →
                        Filter.Tendsto g (nhdsWithin x₀ s) (nhds a) →

```

```lean
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K]
  [inst_3 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_4 : IsDedekindDomain R] {I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K},
```

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup β]
  {p : ENNReal} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],

      ∀ {f : ℕ → α → β} {g : α → β},
```


## S5-CLM-00007491 — Complex\.integral\_boundary\_rect\_of\_hasFDerivAt\_real\_off\_countable

- 归属 / Attribution：The mathlib Community

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {E : Type u} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] (f : ℂ → E) (f' : ℂ → ℂ →L[ℝ] E) (z w : ℂ)
  (s : Set ℂ),
  s.Countable →
    ContinuousOn f (Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (min z.re w.re) (max z.re w.re) ×ℂ Set.Ioo (min z.im w.im) (max z.im w.im) \ s,
          HasFDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun z => Complex.I • (f' z) 1 - (f' z) Complex.I)
            (Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im) MeasureTheory.volume →
          (((∫ (x : ℝ) in z.re..w.re, f (↑x + ↑z.im * Complex.I)) -
                  ∫ (x : ℝ) in z.re..w.re, f (↑x + ↑w.im * Complex.I)) +
                Complex.I • ∫ (y : ℝ) in z.im..w.im, f (↑w.re + ↑y * Complex.I)) -
              Complex.I • ∫ (y : ℝ) in z.im..w.im, f (↑z.re + ↑y * Complex.I) =
            ∫ (x : ℝ) in z.re..w.re,
              ∫ (y : ℝ) in z.im..w.im, Complex.I • (f' (↑x + ↑y * Complex.I)) 1 - (f' (↑x + ↑y * Complex.I)) Complex.I
```

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K]
  [inst_3 : IsFractionRing R K] [inst_4 : IsDedekindDomain R] {I : FractionalIdeal (nonZeroDivisors R) K},
  I ≠ 0 →

          I
```

- 来源定位 / Source pointer：https://github\.com/leanprover\-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Field/Approximation\.lean\#L48\-L108

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : NormedField K] {f g : Polynomial K} {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {a : K},
      Polynomial.eval a f = 0 →
        f.Monic →
          g.Monic →
            g.natDegree = f.natDegree →
              (∀ (i : ℕ), ‖g.coeff i - f.coeff i‖ < ε) →
                g.Splits → ∃ b ∈ g.roots, ‖a - b‖ < ((↑f.natDegree + 1) * ε) ^ (↑f.natDegree)⁻¹ * max ‖a‖ 1
```

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : DistribLattice α] [inst_1 : CommSemiring β] [inst_2 : LinearOrder β]
  [IsStrictOrderedRing β] [ExistsAddOfLE β] (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : α → β) [inst_5 : DecidableEq α],
  0 ≤ f₁ →
    0 ≤ f₂ →
      0 ≤ f₃ →
        0 ≤ f₄ →
          (∀ (a b : α), f₁ a * f₂ b ≤ f₃ (a ⊓ b) * f₄ (a ⊔ b)) →
            ∀ (s t : Finset α), (∑ a ∈ s, f₁ a) * ∑ a ∈ t, f₂ a ≤ (∑ a ∈ s ⊼ t, f₃ a) * ∑ a ∈ s ⊻ t, f₄ a
```


### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {P : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : NormedField 𝕜]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 V] [inst_3 : MetricSpace P] [inst_4 : NormedAddTorsor V P] {t : Affine.Triangle 𝕜 P}
  {p : Fin 3 → P} {p' : P},
  (∀ (i : Fin 3), p i ≠ t.points (i + 2)) →
    (∀ (i : Fin 3), p i ∈ affineSpan 𝕜 {t.points (i + 1), t.points (i + 2)}) →
      (∀ (i : Fin 3), p' ∈ affineSpan 𝕜 {t.points i, p i}) →
        ∏ i, dist (t.points (i + 1)) (p i) / dist (p i) (t.points (i + 2)) = 1
```

```lean
  [inst_8 : NormedSpace ℂ F₃] [CompleteSpace F₁] [CompleteSpace F₂] [CompleteSpace F₃] [inst_12 : NormedSpace ℂ F₁]
  [inst_13 : NormedSpace ℂ F₂] (B : F₁ →L[ℂ] F₂ →L[ℂ] F₃) {f₁ : E → F₁} {f₂ : E → F₂},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f₁ MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable f₂ MeasureTheory.volume →
      Continuous f₁ →
        Continuous f₂ →
          ∀ (ξ : E),
            FourierTransform.fourier (MeasureTheory.convolution f₁ f₂ B MeasureTheory.volume) ξ =
              (B (FourierTransform.fourier f₁ ξ)) (FourierTransform.fourier f₂ ξ)
```


- 来源定位 / Source pointer：https://github\.com/leanprover\-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/Analysis/SumIntegralComparisons\.lean\#L246\-L289

- 归属 / Attribution：The mathlib Community

### 数学或形式化陈述 / Mathematical or formal statement

```lean
∀ {a b : ℕ} {f g : ℝ → ℝ},
  a ≤ b →
    AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc ↑a ↑b) →
      MonotoneOn g (Set.Icc (↑a - 1) (↑b - 1)) →
        0 ≤ f ↑b → 0 ≤ g (↑a - 1) → ∫ (x : ℝ) in ↑a..↑b, f x * g (x - 1) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f ↑i * g ↑i
```
